My girls (3&5) play with it more than pretty much any other toy, between the babies, their mom, and the cage itself. You can reload the babies and have them fall down again, and they’ve figured that out all by themselves which is kinda fun. They also have a cousin who has one who is 8 and she STILL plays with it.
